statusChips.handledPutOutOrConfirmed: Handled: put out, or confirmed safe
statusChips.thereWasNoFireOr: There was no fire or smoke
statusChips.fireIsInViewRight: Fire is in view right now
statusChips.smokeIsInViewRight: Smoke is in view right now

analytics.noScoredIncidentsInThis: No scored incidents in this window
analytics.incidentsRecordedWithoutADetector: Incidents recorded without a detector confidence are left out of the audit.
analytics.peakDetectorConfidenceOfV0: Peak detector confidence of {{v0}} incidents. Operator verdicts stand in for ground truth: false positives clustering at low confidence point to the threshold, high-confidence ones to the scene.
analytics.lowestPerKindThresholdV0: Lowest per-kind threshold {{v0}}: a box below it is never counted.
analytics.fireAndSmokeIncidentsWhen: Fire and smoke incidents: when, where, how often the detector sees them, and how fast they were handled. Times in {{TIMEZONE}}.
analytics.noCameraConfirmedFireOr: No camera confirmed fire or smoke in this window. Try a longer window or another camera.
analytics.incidentsPerCameraAllCameras: Incidents per camera, all cameras; darker bars see it in more of their checks (10% / 30%)
analytics.incidentsByWeekdayAndHour: Incidents by weekday and hour of day — hover a cell for the count
analytics.couldNotLoadTheConfidence: Could not load the confidence audit
analytics.atOrAboveTheDetection: At or above the detection-rate threshold, or with any fire incident.
analytics.everyCameraSNumbersAdded: Every camera's numbers added up per {{v0}}.
analytics.detectionRateIsTheShare: Detection rate is the share of the detector's checks that saw fire or smoke; days count the days with at least one incident.

dashboard.whatEveryCameraSeesRight: What every camera sees right now, and the alerts still waiting on someone.
dashboard.registerAnRtspSourceTo: Register an RTSP source to start watching for fire and smoke.
dashboard.anIncidentAppearsHereOnce: An incident appears here once a camera has seen fire or smoke in 3 of its last 5 checks — a single flicker never alarms.

eventDetail.someoneIsOnItThe: Someone is on it. The emergency alert stops showing on every console.
eventDetail.itWasDealtWithPut: It was dealt with: put out, or checked and found safe.
eventDetail.thereWasNoFireOr: There was no fire or smoke (a reflection, steam, a light). Counted against the detector in analytics.
eventDetail.eGFireTeamCalled: e.g. Fire team called; extinguished with CO2, logged as FS-1042
eventDetail.annotatedFootageFromBeforeThe: Annotated footage from before the incident was confirmed until after it.
eventDetail.theClipIsStillRecording: The clip is still recording; it is saved shortly after the alert.
eventDetail.noClipRecordedForThis: No clip recorded for this incident. A clip is saved shortly after the alert fires; older ones are removed by retention.
eventDetail.theAnnotatedFrameCapturedThe: The annotated frame captured the moment the incident was confirmed.
eventDetail.noFrameStoredForThis: No frame stored for this incident

events.everyFireAndSmokeIncident: Every fire and smoke incident the cameras confirmed, newest first.
events.tryWideningTheStatusKind: Try widening the status, kind, camera or date filter.
events.incidentsAppearHereAsSoon: Incidents appear here as soon as a camera confirms fire or smoke.

systemStatus.whatTheApiIsRunning: What the API is running, and the tuning values it is running with.
systemStatus.everyWorkerTheStreamManager: Every worker the stream manager currently holds. A worker that is running but not connected is retrying its RTSP source.
systemStatus.nothingIsBeingAnalysedEnable: Nothing is being analysed. Enable a camera and start its worker.

userForm.atLeast8CharactersWith: At least 8 characters, with upper, lower, a digit and a symbol.
userForm.adminsSeeEveryWorkspaceWhatever: Admins see every workspace whatever is chosen here.
userForm.theAccountOnlySeesThese: The account only sees these workspaces' cameras, alerts and items.

users.consoleAccountsAndTheirRoles: Console accounts and their roles. There is no public signup: every account is created here.
users.youCannotDeleteYourOwn: You cannot delete your own account
users.createTheFirstOperatorOr: Create the first operator or viewer account.
users.usernameWillLoseAccessTo: "{{username}}" will lose access to the console immediately.
users.aNewTemporaryPasswordWill: A new temporary password will be generated for "{{username}}" and every existing session for the account will be signed out.

workspaces.name: Name
workspaces.membersSeeThisWorkspaceS: Members see this workspace's cameras, alerts and items. Admins see every workspace.
workspaces.deactivatedHiddenFromItsMembers: Deactivated: hidden from its members, kept for admins
workspaces.eachWorkspaceHasItsOwn: Each workspace has its own cameras and incidents, and its alerts go to its members. Members see only their workspaces; admins see all of them.
workspaces.theDefaultWorkspaceCannotBe: The Default workspace cannot be deleted
workspaces.nameIsDeletedWithIts: "{{name}}" is deleted with its {{camera_count}} camera(s) and every incident, frame and clip in it. This cannot be undone.

cameraDetail.detectionOutputAsItHappens: Detection output as it happens: fire boxes in red, smoke in grey.
cameraDetail.theWorkerSLatestFrame: The worker's latest frame, or a one-shot grab when it is stopped.
cameraDetail.noFrameTheRtspSource: No frame — the RTSP source is not answering
cameraDetail.notRunningNothingFromThis: Not running. Nothing from this camera is being analysed.
cameraDetail.aKindBecomesAnIncident: A kind becomes an incident once it is seen in {{v0}} of the last {{v1}} checks. Pending: fire {{v2}}, smoke {{v3}}.
cameraDetail.noFireOrSmokeIn: No fire or smoke in view
cameraDetail.theDetectorSLatestCheck: The detector's latest check found nothing above the confidence thresholds.
cameraDetail.startTheWorkerToWatch: Start the worker to watch this camera.
cameraDetail.thisAlsoDeletesEveryIncident: This also deletes every incident this camera raised, with its frames and clips.

cameraForm.aFireBoxNeedsAt: A fire box needs at least this score to count. InsightEye used 0.5.
cameraForm.theSameForSmokeLower: The same for smoke. Lower it for a camera that sees smoke only faintly.
cameraForm.sightingsNeededWithinTheWindow: Sightings needed within the window below before the alert goes out.
cameraForm.theDetectorChecksAboutTwice: The detector checks about twice a second, so 5 checks is 2.5 s.
cameraForm.anIncidentClosesOnceNothing: An incident closes once nothing has been seen for this long.
cameraForm.seenAgainWithinThisLong: Seen again within this long of clearing, the same incident reopens — no new alert.
cameraForm.alertOnAtLeastOne: Alert on at least one of fire and smoke
cameraForm.aRunningWorkerIsRestarted: A running worker is restarted when you save, so changes take effect at once.
cameraForm.anEnabledCameraStartsWatching: An enabled camera starts watching for fire and smoke as soon as it is saved.
cameraForm.name: Name
cameraForm.mustBeUniqueWithinThis: Must be unique within this workspace.
cameraForm.rtspUserPassHost554: rtsp://user:pass@host:554/stream, or a file path inside the API container for testing.
cameraForm.alertsReadBuildingFloorN: Alerts read "Building - Floor n - Zone - Area", so responders know where to go. Analytics can group cameras by any of them.
cameraForm.freeFormUsedInAlerts: Free-form; used in alerts when the fields above are empty.
cameraForm.leaveAFieldBlankTo: Leave a field blank to inherit the global value from the API's environment. A blank is not zero.

cameraList.rtspSourcesBeingWatchedFor: RTSP sources being watched for fire and smoke.
cameraList.name: Name
cameraList.addAnRtspSourceAnd: Add an RTSP source and a detection worker will start watching it for fire and smoke.
cameraList.thisAlsoDeletesEveryIncident: This also deletes every incident this camera raised, with its frames and clips.
